item.title: A little about me
item.description: About Me I’m Hubert, a 23 y/o student from Lodz, Poland with aspirations to become a graphics programmer. I made this blog for a couple of reasons, mostly because I believe documenting my work makes me remember it better. It also forces me to read up on the things I did not understand well enough before, since, well, I do not want to sound incompetent ;) I hope I can also provide some more learning material for newcomers to this somewhat obscure field.

item.title: In-scattering for spot lights
item.description: In short This post will cover my work on light scattering in game Guiding Light developed using DirectX 11 for ZTGK 2024 competition. Our work was awarded the main prize in the Game Development category and received a special award from Activision. Picture showing the results of my work. Chosen method I needed to find a method that wouldn’t take me much time to implement. We were tasked with making a game in parallel with it’s own game engine in 3 months, there wasn’t much time for sophisticated methods, nor was it necessary given the overall theme of our game.
